name: Mental Retardation
overview: Scripture affirms God's sovereign creation and care for every individual, including those with mental retardation, as seen in Psalms 139:13 where God forms us intimately in the womb. Believers are called to support and value the weak and lowly among them, reflecting Christ's teaching that it is more blessed to give than to receive (Acts 20:35). We are urged to adopt humility and condescend to those of low estate without pride (Romans 12:16), recognizing that failing to do good toward others is sin (James 4:17). Ultimately, God promises to defend and honor the feeble, likening them to the strength of David and the presence of the angel of the LORD (Zechariah 12:8).
